tasks.text: Gather Mercury docs (Articles, EIN letter, owner IDs, address)
tasks.notes: Oct 14 ~3:41 PM ET: Northwest uploaded Initial Resolution for Collins Park Enterprises LLC (email to austin.a.munoz@gmail.com) — download with Articles. Oct 14, 2026: Northwest Registered Agent says the state approved Collins Park Enterprises LLC; formation documents (Articles) and an Operating Agreement template are in the Northwest account (emails to austin.a.munoz@gmail.com). Next: download Articles, complete/sign Operating Agreement, get EIN (IRS online, free), then apply. Mercury (FL LLC) needs: (1) state-filed Articles of Organization; (2) IRS-issued EIN doc — CP575, 147c, or IRS-returned SS-4 (not blank app) or EIN confirmation screenshot; (3) government photo ID for every 25%+ owner and at least one person with operating control (DL/passport/etc.); (4) legal name, industry/description, physical operating address (residential OK; no registered-agent/PO Box/UPS Store), source of funds, U.S. ops details; beneficial-owner home addresses (no PO boxes). Apply at mercury.com. Typical decision 0–2 business days; check spam; follow up after 7 business days if silent. Optional: link Chase via Plaid to expedite. Sources: Mercury Eligibility, Gathering your documents, After you submit (Oct 2026).
